deskEvm.role: desk EVM address: Hyperliquid master, Orderly account owner, EIP-3009 `from`

depositEvm.role: a 1Click-style EVM deposit address (sendAsset destination, EIP-3009 `to`)

key_note: Public test keys (secp256k1 private keys 0x01..01, 0x02..02, 0x03..03). Never fund them. ECDSA signatures are RFC 6979 deterministic with low s, so every library gives the same r, s, v; MPC signatures will differ but must recover to the same address.

strings.rule: px: canonical decimal > 0, <= 6 - szDecimals decimals, integer or <= 5 significant figures; sz: canonical decimal > 0, <= szDecimals decimals (zero size is E_SIZE). The contract validates and never rounds.
strings.format_cases_note: engine side only: nktkas formatPrice / formatSize round DOWN; the Python SDK examples round half-even instead, so the engine must use one rule (round down is safe for both sides of the book only with a band check)

hex_cases.note: lowercased before signing; Hyperliquid lowercases before it verifies
EIP-55 input is lowercased in every action

strings.fee_rate_cases_note: FeeConfig.hl_builder_tenth_bps -> ApproveBuilderFee.maxFeeRate: f / 1000 as a canonical decimal, then "%"

referral_code_cases.note: referral_codes.hyperliquid is None: hl_set_referrer refuses, setup skips it

order_policy.rule: check order: asset in policy (E_ASSET) -> tif in {Ioc,Gtc,Alo} and cloid 0x+32 hex (E_ARGS) -> px/sz strings (E_DECIMAL; zero size E_SIZE) -> notional px*sz <= cap, unpriced symbols use unpriced_max_notional_usd (E_SIZE) -> unpriced: done, no band -> oracle age <= oracle_max_age_s (E_ORACLE_STALE) -> |px - oracle| * 10000 <= band_bps * oracle (E_PRICE_BAND); edges are inclusive
order_policy.oracle_note: keyed by policy symbol for brevity; the contract maps symbols to OutLayer asset ids (C6)
